snippets.instruction: Delete keys of a map of strings
Use cloned strings for map keys
targets:
str_to_number: map[string]int

str_to_number[strings.clone("Hello!")] = 5
str_to_number[strings.clone("Hi!")] = 1
str_to_number[strings.clone("Dynamically allocated!")] = 7
str_to_number[strings.clone("Constant!")] = 42
str_to_number[strings.clone("Dynamic!")] = 8

for key, value in str_to_number {
	delete(key)
}

delete(str_to_number)

item_data: map[string]int

item_data[strings.clone("timber")] = 200
item_data[strings.clone("gadget")] = 1
item_data[strings.clone("storm")] = 7
item_data[strings.clone("meadow")] = 10
item_data[strings.clone("gadget")] = 42

for entry, item in item_data {
	delete(entry)
}

delete(item_data)

value_list: map[string]int

value_list[strings.clone("widget")] = 128
value_list[strings.clone("gadget")] = 1
value_list[strings.clone("stone")] = 42
value_list[strings.clone("widget")] = 200
value_list[strings.clone("gadget")] = 13

for score, data in value_list {
	delete(score)
}

delete(value_list)

entry_map: map[string]int

entry_map[strings.clone("widget")] = 7
entry_map[strings.clone("gadget")] = 1
entry_map[strings.clone("branch")] = 13
entry_map[strings.clone("widget")] = 128
entry_map[strings.clone("branch")] = 100

for size, result in entry_map {
	delete(size)
}

delete(entry_map)

data_store: map[string]int

data_store[strings.clone("shadow")] = 42
data_store[strings.clone("widget")] = 1
data_store[strings.clone("raven")] = 100
data_store[strings.clone("widget")] = 7
data_store[strings.clone("apple")] = 3

for level, entry in data_store {
	delete(level)
}

delete(data_store)

result_set: map[string]int

result_set[strings.clone("gadget")] = 13
result_set[strings.clone("ember")] = 1
result_set[strings.clone("orange")] = 3
result_set[strings.clone("orange")] = 42
result_set[strings.clone("raven")] = 9

for value, score in result_set {
	delete(value)
}

delete(result_set)

count_total: map[string]int

count_total[strings.clone("stone")] = 100
count_total[strings.clone("ember")] = 1
count_total[strings.clone("cloud")] = 9
count_total[strings.clone("raven")] = 13
count_total[strings.clone("orange")] = 25

for count, size in count_total {
	delete(count)
}

delete(count_total)

total_sum: map[string]int

total_sum[strings.clone("meadow")] = 1
total_sum[strings.clone("storm")] = 25
total_sum[strings.clone("raven")] = 100
total_sum[strings.clone("stone")] = 64

for total, level in total_sum {
	delete(total)
}

snippets.instruction: Use an arena allocator for map keys
targets:
arena: vmem.Arena
arena_allocator := vmem.arena_allocator(&arena)
str_to_number: map[string]int

str_to_number["Hello!"] = 5
str_to_number["Hi!"] = 1
str_to_number[strings.clone("Dynamically allocated!", arena_allocator)] = 7
str_to_number["Constant!"] = 42
str_to_number[strings.clone("Dynamic!", arena_allocator)] = 8

vmem.arena_destroy(&arena)
delete(str_to_number)
